## 3. Product & Service Offerings Explained

### 3.1 Cricket Betting ID
Designed specifically for cricket enthusiasts. Offers ball-by-ball micro-markets, session betting (runs in 6/10/20 overs), player props (top batsman/bowler), boundaries, and match-winner odds across all formats (IPL, ICC World Cup, Tests, T20 leagues).

### 3.2 Sports Exchange ID (Back & Lay)
Unlike traditional bookmakers where users only bet against the house, an Exchange ID allows peer-to-peer wagering. Users can "Back" (bet for an outcome) or "Lay" (bet against an outcome), providing higher odds, lower bookmaker margins, and trading/hedging opportunities during live matches.

### 3.3 Self-Deposit Betting ID
The gold standard for modern sports gaming in India. Eliminates reliance on informal local bookies. Users deposit and withdraw funds directly through integrated instant payment methods (UPI, PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, IMPS, Net Banking) with zero broker delays and instant balance reflection.

### 3.4 Casino & Live Dealer ID
Certified access to international live gaming rooms featuring high-definition streaming with real human dealers for Live Teen Patti, Andar Bahar, Roulette, Blackjack, and Baccarat.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is a Betting ID and why do I need one?
A Betting ID is a secure, personal user credential (username and encrypted password) that grants access to regulated online sports exchange platforms. Because major exchanges operate via verified master agent structures in India, you receive your authenticated account and balance management directly through a verified provider like DREAMEXCH24.

### How quickly can I get a Cricket ID from DREAMEXCH24?
Accounts are generated and handed over in under 5 minutes. You contact our WhatsApp desk (+91 9549376324), state your preferred platform, complete a quick verification check, and receive your credentials instantly.

### Is Self-Deposit safe?
Yes. Self-deposit accounts allow you to manage funds directly using standard Indian banking protocols (UPI, IMPS). There are no secondary brokers holding your money.

### What is the difference between a Bookie ID and an Exchange ID?
A Bookie ID only permits betting against predetermined house odds. An Exchange ID lets you act as both bettor and layer, trading positions in real-time with superior market odds and higher liquidity.
